definitions.explanation: Used to direct someone's attention to something, often while pointing.
Used when trying to recall something or when expecting the listener to know what you mean.
Used when something predicted comes true or to emphasize a point.

examples.english: Look, there's a cat over there.

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦っけ→っけ：10739_kke⟧。
examples.english: You know, the person we met last week, who was it again?

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。
examples.english: See? It's just like I said.

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦{起|お}きない→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Come on, if you don't get up soon you'll be late.

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦みて→見る：00283_miru⟧。
ほら、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧、⟦{何|なん}て→なんて：06918_nante⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦っけ→っけ：10739_kke⟧。
examples.english: You know, that movie, what was it called again?
You know, I'm talking about him, the tall guy.

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧、⟦{覚|おぼ}えてる→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧？
examples.english: You know, the restaurant we went to last year, do you remember?
You know, it's the shop on that corner.

examples.japanese: ほら⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧、⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}ってきた→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: See? I told you it would rain.

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。
examples.english: See? That's why I told you.

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: See? It turned out exactly as I said.

examples.japanese: ほら、⟦{気|き}をつけない→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{転|ころ}んだ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦ん→の：09472_no⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: See? You fell because you weren't careful.

notes:
REGISTER: Casual to neutral. Can sound pushy or condescending if overused with superiors or strangers.

NUANCES BY CONTEXT:
- ほら⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧: "Look at this" (directing attention)
- ほら、⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧: "You know, that thing" (trying to recall)
- ほら⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: "See? Told you" (vindication)
- ほら！: "Come on!" (urging action)

PRONUNCIATION:
- Rising: trying to get attention or recall
- Flat/falling: pointing out or emphasizing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧: "look" (more direct)
- ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧（⟦ねえ→ねえ：06913_nee⟧）: "hey" (attention-getting)
- ⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧: "that's why/I told you" (emphasizing point)

CAUTION: Can come across as bossy or condescending in formal situations. Use more polite alternatives like ⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ or ⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ in professional contexts.
